shared_contracts.summary: Updated: GPT-5 model, DOCX/TXT file support, localStorage API key storage.
Default document types and common review items for first-run initialization.
ResponsesAPIResponse includes output_text. File extraction: DOCX (mammoth), TXT (FileReader).

integration_points: app/page.tsx calls initializeDefaultData on mount and refreshes document list after upload/failure.
components/documents/document-upload-section.tsx creates document, invokes OpenAI review, sets completed/failed status, and notifies parent.
components/settings/api-key-settings.tsx stores API key in localStorage (not encrypted); key included in full backup export.
lib/storage/local-storage.ts is the central persistence boundary for all app state.
known_issues: API key stored in localStorage as plaintext — acceptable for client-side app but noted for future server-proxy phase.
PDF and legacy DOC (.doc) files not supported for text extraction; only DOCX and TXT are supported.
No browser E2E tests; verification relies on typecheck + build + harness phase validation.
claude.md is stale and references outdated Supabase/API-route architecture.
